scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Saturday’s apartment plant-swap arrival from creating an avoidable curbside problem.
Emerging Need: A preliminary street-work notice becomes relevant only after the gathering and a car-dependent drop-off are confirmed, then a final tow-zone notice overlaps the arrival window.
Decision Context: Observable plans establish timing, location, and who is driving with bulky items; a pre-existing home-access note supplies the safe alternate loading option.
Consequence: Timely awareness can reduce the risk of a citation, towing scare, or awkward unloading before anyone leaves, but waiting until departure leaves the prevention window closed.

parameter.subject: Preliminary notice: utility marking on SE Maple next week
parameter.body: City contractors may mark pavement on SE Maple between 7th and 8th next week. Temporary curb restrictions are possible if the work permit is finalized; confirmed tow-zone notices will follow separately.

parameter.title: Riverside plant clipping swap and soup
parameter.description: Small apartment gathering for soup, story excerpts, and labeled plant clippings.

parameter.content: I can bring the long herb flat and the soup pot Saturday. I’ll drive and aim for the front curb around 10:35 because the flat won’t fit in my bike basket.

parameter.subject: Confirmed temporary no-parking zone for SE Maple: Saturday morning
parameter.body: A temporary no-parking and no passenger-loading zone will be enforced on SE Maple between 7th and 8th from 9:00 a.m. to noon on Saturday, Nov. 7. Vehicles stopping in the signed zone may be cited or towed while paving equipment is staged.

parameter.content: Loading the herb flat now and putting my phone in the crate so it doesn’t get damp. I should be at your front curb right at 10:40.
